title: The Power of Organic Farming | Chuck Kayser | TEDxKUFS
summary: Organic market gardener's TEDx talk urging people to grow their own vegetables and buy organic.

assertions.quote: there are scientific reports, statistics, and other evidence that organics is a better choice than conventional agriculture
Growing vegetables is a great way to relax and focus on something other than the stress

verdicts.note: Gardening studies show modest gains in activity and wellbeing, mostly from observational and small trials.
